P1.source: Read Theorem1/p.5, Assumption1/p.4, Assumption2/p.7, AppendixA Eq.(3)/p.15 and B.4 proof/p.17.
P1.independent_argument: For Path7 partition 123|456|7, boundaries are 3|46|7. Ordered cross-cluster boundary contributions to NI1/8 are 3rho+3rho+3rho+rho=10rho=5. Only cut edges 34 and 67 contribute to the proposed first term, giving (2*7/3)*(2rho)=14/3. The 8/N multiplier restores I1=40/N versus bound112/(3N), preserving the violation. Sigma=.5I+.5J has eigenvalues .5 and4; all distinct-pair entries are .5, so every applicable three-distinct-region covariance inequality holds with equality.
P1.hypotheses_and_alternatives: Clusters and path are connected, closed neighborhoods are used, p=.5 cluster assignments are independent, and m=3<=7^(2/3). Constant covariates and oracle known g with neighborhood-only dependence meet the stated premises. Balanced means p=.5 in the actual source, not equal cardinality. Equal cardinality would remove this particular counterexample but is not an algorithmic restriction.
P1.dependency_severity_and_repair: Major retained: the p.17 two-cluster argument yields |Cj|+|Ck|, which can exceed 2R/m. Section3.2 delegates the general surrogate to AppendixA. The claim does not refute the two-cluster bound or empirically selected designs; exact-MSE ranking does not validate the false surrogate bound. A constrained partition class or new proved bound is needed, without an asserted complete repair.

P2.source: Read compute_similarity and active graph_cut_algo/multi_graph_cut, plus utils_semi overlap-count objective.
P2.independent_argument: The active similarity is (R/m)*Vplus*(W+I)-V. For distinct cross-cluster endpoints it has coefficient R/m versus Eq.(3) 2R/m; -V has the same coefficient in both. Diagonal additions cancel in diag(S1)-S. Scaling the complete Laplacian doubles -V too and cannot equate these objectives.
P2.alternative_and_dependency: The released version may intentionally choose another candidate surrogate; the exact overlap-count MSE still ranks candidates downstream. No historical command/figure linkage is supplied.
P2.severity_and_repair: Minor retained as a version-specific objective mismatch, not an experimental failure. Reconciliation of coefficient and run provenance is required; no author program executed.

P3.source: Read ClusterDesign propensity_score_smooth indexed branch lines165-175 and active pooled/local callers lines323-324,363-364 against exact probability Eq.(1) p.4.
P3.independent_argument: For four Bernoulli(.5) cluster assignments, only the all-one assignment has Y=product A=1; all-zero outcome is0. With nuisance identically0 fixed independently, exact weighted expectation is (1/16)/(1/16)=1, clipped expectation (1/16)/(1/8)=.5. This verifies the discrepancy without executing the author estimator.
P3.alternative_and_dependency: Correct outcome regression can zero the augmentation residual; clipping may deliberately reduce variance. The exact-probability theoretical estimator is not contradicted and historical clipping frequency is unknown.
P3.severity_and_repair: Minor retained for released estimator/theory mismatch. Exact weights restore this fixed-nuisance unbiasedness, or a separate clipped-estimator bias analysis is needed; no full practical estimator repair is certified.
